assign.outcome:
**`/framework/ext/Panel/playground/` built: the whole-window Workspace, its viewport set (fill/one/all/twin), the drawer's own grip as the responsive handle.**

![](playground.png)

- **The shell** — left rail composes `core/Sidebar` (`Rail extends Sidebar`, only `menu()` replaced): Framework's own logo/brand is the way out, no ✕; the document list (the open one lit); `+` mints `untitled` and the Router navigates there. Main: the `Workspace` with its bar. Right: `ext/drawer` docked at load — its `ext/grip` narrows the `fill` view 1:1, zero new code for that part. `route(name)` claims any segment (the day page's own pattern), so `/playground/<name>/` and the bare `/playground/` (→ `default`) share one builder.
- **`Workspace/viewports.js`** — `fill` (default, 100%, the rail is the handle) · `one` (a device width) · `all` (all four, one row, zoomed to fit) · `twin` (390 beside 3440, one height via `ext/demo/twin.js`'s `pane()`). All seven boxes (fill + 4 device frames + 2 twin panes) mount ONCE — `mount()` only grows `$roots[]`, so a mode switch shows/hides rather than leaking a box per switch. `Fit`/`100%`, a manual zoom dial and a px readout — `simulate`/`watch`/`magnifier`/`ruler` lifted as exports from `ext/demo/stage.js`, `pane` from `twin.js` (now `twin(fn, devices)`); `demo`'s own strip unchanged.
- **`--rail-push`** — the drawer readme's "proposed, not applied" token now exists (`drawer.css`, on `.app`) and `.layout-full` reads it instead of restating the push formula.
- **Two real bugs, caught live and fixed**: `ruler()` was handed a readout span before it existed (build order); `pane()` nested inside a column wrapper turned its width-flex-basis into a height one, so `twin`'s two panes landed at different heights until the label moved INSIDE the box instead of below it.
- **Proven headless**, `.active-page`-scoped (an inactive document's whole Workspace stays live in the DOM, `Page.css`'s arrangement contract): rail lists `default`; `+` → url follows to `/untitled/`; `all` → 4 frames labelled 390/810/1440/3440px; `Fit` → all four zoom < 1, zero page overflow at 1600; `twin` → two panes, equal height to the pixel; `fill` → zoom 1; the drawer's grip dragged 200px narrows the fill view ~193px (rounding); zero console errors on `/ext/Panel/`, `/playground/`, `/Workspace/`, `/demo/`, `/ext/editor/`, `/ext/files/`, `/space/compose/`. `untitled` removed at the end, `public/data` clean.

**Left, named:** `one` always shows `desktop` — no device picker yet. The manual zoom dial is a no-op in `all`/`twin` (no single box to drag) — still drawn, for a steady bar. `framework.css`'s own `.app` padding-inline-end still restates the `--rail-push` formula directly rather than reading the token (out of this task's fence).
